svg.title: OpenGuardrail target architecture: execution guardrails for agents
svg.desc: Target architecture of OpenGuardrail, illustrated by CD delivery. An external agent reads checks and evaluation context through a reference Skill and guardrailctl, investigates observation systems and submits findings and evidence. The CLI and management UI call the same OpenAPI service. GuardrailSpec defines policy revisions, checks and evidence requirements. Runs freeze policy references, evaluation context and deadlines. The service validates submission structure and completeness, but does not independently attest to observations. Stored decisions include a validity window; the CD integration verifies evidence and validity before acting. Execution Claims and receipts, replaceable identity, delivery and telemetry providers, and some CD integrations remain planned. SQLite and PostgreSQL support one service instance per database in the preview. Blue indicates product components; gray indicates the agent and external systems. Asterisks mark planned capabilities.
